item.title: Join hundreds in Monaco’s iconic Pink Ribbon Walk on 15th February
item.description: The 15th Pink Ribbon Monaco Walk is set to return at Port Hercule on February 15th, attracting hundreds of participants in support of women's cancer awareness and early detection.

item.title: Historic ocean treaty comes into force to protect the high seas
item.description: A landmark UN treaty protecting nearly half the planet's ocean has officially entered into force, marking a new era for marine conservation. So what does it mean?

item.title: Princess Grace Irish Library to explore Princess Grace’s Irish heritage in upcoming talk
item.description: The Princess Grace Irish Library is set to host a talk by historian Neal Doherty on January 22nd, exploring the Irish ancestry of Princess Grace.

item.title: Rita Ora to headline St. Moritz gala during Snow Polo World Cup
item.description: British pop star Rita Ora will perform at the Big Art Festival Gala in St. Moritz on Sunday 25th January, bringing chart-topping hits to the Alpine resort during its prestigious Snow Polo World Cup.

item.title: Prince Albert II meets Pope Leo XIV at the Vatican, extends invitation to Monaco
item.description: Pope Leo XIV held talks with Prince Albert II at the Vatican on Saturday, where the two leaders found common ground on environmental protection and human rights.

item.title: Palace reassures public after Prince Albert undergoes minor facial procedure
item.description: The Palace has moved to reassure the public after Prince Albert II underwent a brief medical procedure to remove a benign growth from his scalp and face.

item.title: Italy edges out Denmark in thrilling Monaco Optimist Team Race finale
item.description: Young sailors from Yacht Club Italiano clinched victory in the 14th Monaco Optimist Team Race after an intense final-day battle with Danish rivals.

item.title: Prince Albert sends condolences to Spain after deadly train crash
item.description: Prince Albert II has expressed his shock and sadness following the train crash in southern Spain that killed at least 39 people on Sunday.

item.title: What is the EU trade ‘bazooka’ that could hit back at Trump?
item.description: The European Union is facing calls to deploy a powerful but untested trade tool following US President Donald Trump's threat to impose tariffs of up to 25% on multiple European nations over Greenland.

item.title: Mayor Georges Marsan presents La Mairie’s vision for 2026
item.description: Mayor Georges Marsan, accompanied by several members of the Town Council, presented ambitious plans for the principality during his annual New Year address to the press this morning.
